title: Building with Claude Code: Inside Notion's AI development workflow
description:
This webinar showcases Notion's partnership with Anthropic in shaping the future of AI-assisted development. We'll explore three key stories: how Notion served as a design partner in Claude Code's early development, providing critical feedback that shaped the product and how Notion's engineering teams deploy Claude Code today across their organization to accelerate development workflows.

Through live demos and candid conversation, we'll share practical insights on leveraging Claude Sonnet 4.5 to transform how developers work, from Notion's engineering leaders who are living this transformation daily.
